name: cavalry
description: Create and refine editable motion in Cavalry through its native local MCP server and structured timing actions.

interface.shortDescription: Motion graphics through Cavalry's local MCP
interface.longDescription: A personal Codex plugin that connects to Cavalry's native MCP server. Includes its documentation, scripting, scene inspection, previews, and three structured keyframe actions: stagger, retime, and loop closure. Keep Cavalry open with its MCP server enabled.
defaultPrompt: Stagger the selected animation in Cavalry by 3 frames per layer.
Retime the selected keyframes to twice their duration.
